method: Three ordinary pictures actually inspected; standard viewer PMTiles/global Terrarium only, no bespoke survey or archive.

references.observed: Whole aerial actually inspected: one U-shaped yellow-and-white principal palace with a large court open through the north gate gap. Two returned north front wings, long side ranges and broad rear transverse range; continuous pale gray sheet-metal hipped roofs with substantial white chimneys, round dormers and a central raised attic/pediment. Central and two side court stairs descend from the raised palace floor. Independent curved outbuildings and the full garden remain context.

Court facade actually inspected: basement window strip, two principal tall-window levels, white giant pilasters/rusticated lower surrounds and yellow wall fields. The center has three closed entrance doors reached by a broad stair, a small upper balcony, three tall upper windows and a low attic with short windows/triangular pediment. Round roof dormers and large ornamented chimneys; fine relief and inventories may be original abstractions.

North gate actually inspected: wide open central gap between two returned wings, with two paired pale stone gate posts and dark metal gates/side grilles. Sculptural finials can be original simplified forms. The palace is visible through the gap; do not seal it with a solid front crossrange or invent an enclosed fourth side.
